programs.title: The Shaukeens
programs.desc: Bored of their mundane lives, three 60-something men, immersed in the allure of Mauritius, rekindle their youthful spirits and compete for the attention of a vivacious social media addict, Ahana.

programs.title: Action Jackson
programs.desc: Vishi, a small-time crook, looks like AJ, a professional assassin. AJ convinces Vishi to help him fool the mob so he can be with his wife while she has a baby, and as the crooks close in on Vishi, AJ arrives to deal with them.

programs.title: Fight Club
programs.desc: The movie follows an insomniac office worker who befriends a charismatic soap salesman, and together they start an underground fight club as a way to cope with their mundane lives. As the club gains popularity, they become involved in a larger plan to undermine the consumerist society they live in.
